A '''Corellian potato stick''' was a type of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] snack made from [[Potato/Legends|potatoes]].<ref name="Hostage">'[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] shared a bag of potato sticks with the [[Human/Legends|human]] brothers [[Mazi]], [[Jez (Human)|Jez]], and [[Lan (Human)|Lan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]]<ref name="Hostage" />
